feature_title: Logs Saved View Apply on Build Tab

rationale.edition: The only changed path is web/src/plugins/logs/BuildQueryPage.vue, which lives in the open-source web source tree, not under any enterprise directory (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/). No enterprise-gated keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR) appear in the path or the changed symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping: the change alters a user-facing UI flow (applying a saved view while on the build tab now re-initializes the query builder), and there is no explicit opt-out marker — no tests-added label was passed and trigger_comment.txt is empty.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because the diff adds a watcher that re-initializes the logs query builder when a saved view is applied without remounting the component. This is user-exercisable behavior — applying a saved view on the build tab should reflect the saved build config — that a Playwright test should verify.
rationale.area: Area is Logs: the changed file lives under web/src/plugins/logs/, and the saved-view concept is a Logs feature. Sibling Playwright specs for logs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/.
rationale.group: Logs-Core is the closest existing matrix shard: it maps to the Logs folder and already carries general logs UI specs (logspage.spec.js, shareLink.spec.js, logstable.spec.js). Saved-view application is a general Logs feature, so the new spec should join this shard; the Engineer may move it to Logs-Queries if it ends up being query-builder-only.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The diff only touches web/src/plugins/logs/BuildQueryPage.vue (a Vue component), with no files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so there is no existing Playwright coverage to enhance — this flag stays false and a new spec is authored.
